description: Look up one NEAR npm or crates.io package, optionally at a version: latest and latest stable version, whether that version is yanked or deprecated, how many stable versions are newer, the registry's deprecation message, and the deprecation entry with its replacement when the package is stale (e.g. near-sdk-js, @near-js/*). Use before adding or upgrading a dependency.

package.description: Package name, optionally with a version and registry: "near-api-js", "near-sdk@5.1.0", "npm:@near-js/accounts@2.5.1", "crates:near-workspaces".

name: resolve_package
